falk_fm_001.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_fm_001.text: Another wanderer. Haven Ridge is not a charity. If you want to stay, you work. If you want to trade, you pay the tariff. If you cause problems — you leave. With or without help.

choices.text: [Barter 45] I have goods worth trading. What's the tariff?
I heard about a signal. A broadcast. What does the Council know about it?

falk_fm_002a.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_fm_002a.text: See the work board on the east wall. First three jobs are mandatory for new arrivals — it's how we assess who's worth keeping. Do them, don't complain, and we'll talk about longer arrangements.

falk_fm_002b_pass.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_fm_002b_pass.text: Ten percent on all transactions inside the ridge. Five percent if you're registered labour. The difference is earned, not given. Show me what you've got.

falk_fm_002b_fail.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_fm_002b_fail.text: Standard rate. Fifteen percent. Non-negotiable. Welcome to Haven Ridge.

falk_fm_002c.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_fm_002c.text: The Council is aware of the signal. We've assessed it as non-threatening — old automated equipment, most likely. I'd ask you not to stir up speculation among the residents. We don't need panic over a radio ghost.

falk_fm_003.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_fm_003.text: Is there anything else you need, or are we done here?

falk_sus_001.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_sus_001.text: You again. I hope this is about something productive.

choices.text: I want to know more about the signal. Your answer felt incomplete.
[Intimidate 55] You're hiding something about that signal.

falk_sus_002.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_sus_002.text: My answer was complete. The Council has investigated. It's old equipment, probably pre-war agricultural automation. If you want to waste your time chasing radio static, that's your business — but don't involve my people.

falk_sus_002b_pass.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_sus_002b_pass.text: ...*long pause* ...You're more perceptive than you look. The signal concerns me. There are elements in this region that would use it as a rallying point. I need it investigated quietly. Can you be quiet?

falk_sus_002b_fail.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_sus_002b_fail.text: Hiding something? I am a public servant. Everything I do is in the interest of this settlement. Watch your tone.

falk_sus_002b_quest.speaker: councilman_falk
falk_sus_002b_quest.text: The signal appears to originate from the old Silo Complex, east-northeast of the Scrapfield. I want to know what's broadcasting and who, if anyone, knows about it. Report back to me. Discretion.
